app.title: Laptop diagnostics kit
warn.not_admin: Warning: you are not administrator. Some checks (SMART, DISM, sensors) will be incomplete.
warn.use_bat: Use Avvia-Diagnostica.bat / Run-Diagnostics.bat and accept UAC.
warn.browser: Could not open the browser automatically.
report.title: Laptop diagnostics
report.no_issues: No serious issues came up in this scan. Keep reports in reports and run again if the PC misbehaves.
report.admin_no: NOT ran as administrator: SMART, DISM and some sensors may be missing.
report.battery_link: Windows battery report: open powercfg battery report
hw.cpu_detail: Logical cores: {0} | Max clock: {1} MHz | WMI load: {2}%
hw.cpu_hot: CPU at the limit. Close heavy processes and check again at idle.
hw.ram_crit: RAM almost full: close programs or consider an upgrade.
hw.ram_warn: High RAM usage. If the PC is slow, close the browser with many tabs.
hw.power_saver: Power saver plan is active: it can reduce performance and CPU clocks.
hw.memdiag_none_detail: No Windows Memory Diagnostic results in the last 90 days.
hw.memdiag_advice: If you get random crashes: Win+R, mdsched.exe, reboot to test RAM.
hw.memdiag_fail: Windows Memory Diagnostic found errors. Run a RAM test (mdsched.exe) and consider replacing the modules.
hw.whea_crit: Update BIOS and chipset drivers. If they persist, test RAM and cooling.
hw.whea_warn: A few WHEA events: watch temperatures and RAM.
disk.name: Disk: {0}
disk.unhealthy: The disk is unhealthy. Back up now and consider replacement.
disk.warning: Disk health is in warning. Backup and monitor SMART.
disk.read_advice: Disk read errors: backup and check SMART.
disk.wear_crit: SSD wear is very high. Backup and replace.
disk.wear_warn: SSD wear is high. Plan a replacement.
disk.space_crit: Disk space under 10%. Free files, Empty Recycle Bin, Settings > System > Storage.
disk.space_warn: Low free space. Windows and updates can fail under 10-15%.
disk.smart_na_detail: smartctl is not installed in tools. The scan uses Windows data.
disk.smart_failed: SMART FAILED. Immediate backup and disk replacement.
disk.smart_not_ok: SMART not OK. Backup and replacement.
disk.realloc_crit: Many reallocated sectors: the disk is dying. Backup and replace it.
disk.realloc_warn: Reallocated sectors > 0: start a backup and monitor.
disk.nvme_crit: NVMe SSD almost worn out. Replace it.
disk.nvme_warn: High NVMe wear. Plan a replacement.
disk.spare_crit: NVMe Available Spare is low. Backup and replace.
bat.name: Battery
bat.not_found_detail: No WMI battery (desktop, battery unplugged, or ACPI driver missing).
bat.wear_crit: Battery is very worn (over 50%). Reduced mobility: consider replacement.
bat.wear_warn: Battery wear above 30%. Runtime is lower than when new.
bat.wear_detail: Design: {0} mWh | Current full charge: {1} mWh
bat.wear_hidden_detail: DesignedCapacity / FullChargedCapacity are not available on this OEM.
bat.cycles_crit: Over 1000 cycles: Li-ion chemistry is typically at end of life.
bat.cycles_warn: High cycle count. Watch wear and runtime.
bat.cycles_hidden_detail: Many OEMs do not publish CycleCount via WMI.
bat.powercfg_advice: Open the powercfg HTML file for 14-day charge history.
th.lhm_exit_detail: ReadSensors.exe produced no data. Some antivirus products block LHM.
th.lhm_missing_detail: ReadSensors.exe is missing. Falling back to Windows ACPI sensors (often empty on laptops).
th.cpu_crit: CPU is very hot. Clean fans/heatsink, use a hard surface, thermal paste, avoid soft surfaces.
th.cpu_warn: CPU is hot. Check that fans are not blocked and the surface is rigid.
th.cpu_hidden_detail: LibreHardwareMonitor did not read CPU thermometers (administrator is often required).
th.cpu_hidden_advice: Rerun Run-Diagnostics.bat as administrator for CPU temperatures.
th.gpu_crit: GPU is very hot. Reduce 3D load, update drivers, clean the fans.
th.gpu_warn: GPU is hot under load. Normal in gaming, unusual at idle.
th.ssd_crit: SSD is too hot. The controller can throttle and shorten NAND life.
th.ssd_warn: SSD is hot. Avoid covers that block vents.
th.fan_zero: Fan at 0 RPM: can be normal at idle (fan stop). If the CPU is hot, it is a problem.
th.acpi_hot: ACPI thermal zone is very hot.
th.none_detail: No temperatures were read. Open tools\LibreHardwareMonitor\LibreHardwareMonitor.exe for a live view.
th.none_advice: You can launch LibreHardwareMonitor from the tools folder to see live sensors.
win.reboot_detail: Updates or CBS require a reboot.
win.reboot_advice: Reboot Windows, then run diagnostics again.
win.dism_repairable: Windows image is repairable. As admin: DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth then sfc /scannow (it takes a while).
win.dism_bad: Windows image is not healthy. DISM RestoreHealth + sfc /scannow, then consider reset or repair install.
win.dism_fail: DISM failed. Rerun as admin or check CBS.log.
win.bsod_advice: Note the bugcheck code. Common causes: GPU/storage drivers, RAM, overheating.
win.kernel41_detail: The PC turned off without a clean shutdown.
win.kernel41_crit: PSU/battery, overheating, drivers or RAM. Also check cables and thermals.
win.kernel41_warn: A dirty shutdown can be a freeze or a power cut.
win.eventlog_advice: Many system errors in 7 days. Open Event Viewer > System.
win.av_advice: Make sure Microsoft Defender is on.
drv.advice: Open Device Manager and look for yellow triangles. Update or reinstall the driver; if unknown, search the vendor ID.
drv.device_advice: In Device Manager: Update driver, or Uninstall device and reboot.
